Notice about pet travel support

Travelers should know that the Companion Animal Travel Desk is here to help when a pet needs extra care before, during, or after a flight. Aurelia Skyways wants each trip to feel calm for both the traveler and the animal, so please share any concern as soon as you notice it.

If a pet seems uneasy, delayed, or hard to track in transit, tell the desk staff right away. <<FACT F120>> The cabin team also watches animals during flight and passes along updates when needed, so travelers should stay in touch with the desk instead of guessing what is happening. Clear details from the traveler help the team look into the matter faster and with less stress for everyone.

When you arrive at the skyport, check in with the desk before boarding if you need support with carriers, transfer steps, or a comfort check for your pet. The team can point you in the right direction and help you follow the right next step without extra confusion.

Please go to the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help and guidance.
